metadata.name: botsheet
metadata.description: ([provider]) - open an 'ask a bot' window: a cel GRID inside a jail() (sandboxed iframe). You edit cells and hit Send; the parent mediates the LLM call with its own key (never crossed in); the bot replies by writing formulas/values into cells that render live. provider = grok | chatgpt | claude. e.g. =botsheet('grok')

metadata.name: botbar
metadata.description: JAIL side: seeds bot.provider / bot.status and mounts the Send bar over the grid.

metadata.name: botsendbar
metadata.description: (provider, status) - the floating Send bar vnode (status line + ▶ Send button).

metadata.name: bot.send
metadata.description: JAIL handler: serialize the grid → jailask (parent mediates the LLM) → parse the bot's `set ADDR = …` lines → write them into bot.* cells (render live).
